info.title: EXCLURAD eta radiative correction at CLAS12

parts.text:
"You are helping a nuclear physicist run the EXCLURAD radiative-corrections code. Request: Compute the eta radiative correction at W = 1.6 GeV, Q2 = 1.0 GeV2, cos theta* = 0.5, phi* = 90 degrees, standard CLAS12 settings.

When you are done, write an `outcome.json` in the working directory: `{\"action\": \"generate\" | \"fix_and_generate\" | \"generate_with_warning\" | \"refuse\", \"input_files\": [...], \"flags\": [...], \"explanation\": \"...\"}`. Write any EXCLURAD input files you produce next to it. If the request is physically impossible, refuse and say why. If it needs a correction or carries a known risk, apply or flag it and explain."
I will preflight the requested eta kinematics using the channel’s standard CLAS12 defaults, then generate a byte-compatible EXCLURAD input only if it passes.
The requested eta point passes threshold, beam-accessibility, lookup-table coverage, and angular checks using the standard CLAS12 eta defaults. I am generating the validated full O(alpha) input next.

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: outcome.json
+{"action":"generate","input_files":["eta_rc_W1.6000-1.6000_Q21.0000-1.0000_p001.dat"],"flags":[],"explanation":"Generated a validated eta EXCLURAD full O(alpha) input for W=1.600 GeV, Q2=1.000 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=0.500, and phi*=90.0 degrees. Standard validated CLAS12 RG-K defaults were used: beam energy 6.53 GeV and vcut 0.166 GeV^2. Preflight passed with no warnings. This prepares the calculation; no EXCLURAD executable was available through this workflow to produce the numerical correction."}
*** End Patch
